title: Perch card envelope (swarm.spine.envelope.v1)
description:
The JSON object inside every ambush:*:v1 card's fenced block. It is a swarm-spine envelope, not a Perch invention: the field set, the ordering of the signing preimage and the hash algorithm are crates/swarm-spine/src/envelope.rs:82-101 (build_signed_envelope), which the daemon already calls once at crates/swarm-runtime/src/approval.rs:1810.

SHIPS UNSIGNED. `envelope_hash` is present from day one because compute_envelope_hash_hex (envelope.rs:47-51) takes no keypair; `signature` is ABSENT until B6 provisions a real key. Adopting the envelope shape now makes B6 a two-field addition instead of a v1->v2 marker bump, and it makes verify_chain_link (chain.rs:75, zero consumers today) runnable immediately, because that function reads only issuer, seq, prev_envelope_hash and envelope_hash and needs no key either.

THE PRESENCE OF envelope_hash DOES NOT RAISE THE TIER. 08 section 6.2 defines tier 1 as a detached Ed25519 signature over the body; a hash with no key is not one. A card with envelope_hash and no signature renders tier 0, and the sequence-continuity result renders as its own separate, non-cryptographic row.

issuer.description: WHO PUBLISHED THIS CARD — the bridge's spine keypair, one per colony. Not the agent that produced the fact; that is `fact.issuer`. verify_chain_link compares issuers after parse_issuer_pubkey_hex + lowercase (chain.rs:36-39), so the hex case is not load-bearing but the prefix is.

seq.description: Per-issuer, per-stream monotonic counter assigned BY THE BRIDGE at publish time. This is the answer to the missing sequence number on GET /v1/events/stream, which sets `.id(emitted_at_ms)` (crates/swarm-ingest-runtime/src/ingest/demo.rs:1703) -- a millisecond timestamp that collides at the concentration monitor's 10 Hz cadence. A gap in `seq` proves the console lost a card. It does NOT prove the bridge received everything the daemon sent: tokio broadcast lag is dropped silently on the receive side (demo.rs:1689, platform_api.rs:1388; zero `Lagged` handling exists anywhere in crates/), so the bridge counts those separately as perch_bridge_broadcast_lagged_total and publishes the count.

prev_envelope_hash.description: Null only on seq 1 for a given issuer and stream.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 with SECOND precision and a `Z` suffix — chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339_opts(SecondsFormat::Secs, true), envelope.rs:13-16. build_signed_envelope parses and rejects anything else (envelope.rs:78-83). This is the PUBLISH instant. The domain instant is fact.emitted_at_ms and every Perch surface sorts on that.

fact.description: The Perch card payload. One of the seven card schemas.

envelope_hash.description: sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of this object with `envelope_hash` and `signature` absent — envelope.rs:42-51, using swarm_crypto::canonicalize_json (lib.rs:37). Keyless.

signature.description: ABSENT until B6. Ed25519 over the same canonical bytes as envelope_hash. When present, and only then, may a card render above tier 0 on the strength of this envelope.
